opening_annotation.data_driven_name: Early Expansion with Gas and Spawning Pool
opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Secure an early expansion while maintaining early gas and a spawning pool for defense or pressure.
supporting_facts: The opening has a 100% rate of first expansion observed, compared to a baseline of 18.7%.
The medoid key sequence is 'Base > Gas > Prod_SpawningPool > Base2 > Combat_queen', indicating a gas before pool build order.
The profile shows a high expansion investment (0.882) and moderate economy (0.465), with no technology or air investment.
The opening has a winrate of 51.4% across 3041 games.
